note: Paths are relative to the FixFlow repository. Documents marked “branch only” live on their pull request’s branch until it merges. The bottleneck compile, harness v2, token report, library, graph-test and split-rule documents hold details of the clinic testbed and this PC, so they stay uncommitted on this PC until I decide otherwise.
